prompt: Seller: AccessProof, a platform that helps digital teams test customer-facing websites and applications for accessibility problems and coordinate remediation. Prospect: Northstar Commerce, a fictional online-retailer practice company. Buyer: Head of Digital Product. Task 1: US retailers with 200-5,000 employees and customer-facing checkout journeys. Task 2: hypothetical upcoming checkout redesign; no launch or accessibility defects have been verified. Signal logic: a redesign is a useful moment to plan accessibility testing; it is not proof of defects. Task 3: the digital-product leader would coordinate the release and remediation. Create a recipient-facing checkout accessibility testing and remediation starter kit: a test plan for product, cart, and checkout; a reusable issue-ticket template; and a release checklist. Mark this as a fictional practice example and a proposed testing plan, not a completed audit. Do not invent findings, screenshots, metrics, customer data, source URLs, or hobbies. Keep qualification/scoring/outreach notes private. No gift. No real website/domain has been supplied.
